name: VM App Preference
description: One row per person for the choices that belong to them rather than to their account: what they do, and what their phone sounds like. Kept off the User doctype on purpose — User is core, and this is ours to change.

fields.label: About
fields.description: One line, the way a status line reads. Optional — it is the only field here nobody is nagged about.

fields.label: Chat Tone
fields.description: A bundled tone id, or `system:<uri>` when the person picked a sound off their own phone. Stored as text rather than a Select so the app can add tones without a migration.

fields.label: Alert Tone
fields.description: Separate from chat on purpose: a breakdown alert at 2am should not sound like a message.

fields.label: Profile Prompt Dismissed At
fields.description: When they last waved the finish-your-profile banner away. The banner returns after a while; it never blocks anything.
